name: beancount-booking
instr:
**bean-check crashes on a FIFO sale**

Since I updated to current master, bean-check dies on a sale from one of my FIFO accounts:

```
TypeError: '<' not supported between instances of 'datetime.date' and 'NoneType'
```

Cut down to one fund:

```beancount
2023-12-01 open Assets:Brokerage:Cash USD
2023-12-01 open Assets:Brokerage:VTI VTI "FIFO"
2023-12-01 open Income:Brokerage:Gains USD
2023-12-01 open Equity:Opening-Balances USD

2023-12-01 * "Deposit"
  Assets:Brokerage:Cash       20000.00 USD
  Equity:Opening-Balances

2024-01-16 * "Buy VTI"
  Assets:Brokerage:VTI          20 VTI {221.40 USD}
  Assets:Brokerage:Cash

2024-05-13 * "Buy VTI"
  Assets:Brokerage:VTI          15 VTI {248.10 USD}
  Assets:Brokerage:Cash

2024-11-19 * "Sell VTI"
  Assets:Brokerage:VTI         -25 VTI {} @ 279.55 USD
  Assets:Brokerage:Cash        6988.75 USD
  Income:Brokerage:Gains
```

That sale should take the 20 January shares and 5 from May, 1320.25 USD of gains. Without
the sale the file loads, but the January lot has no acquisition date in the inventory.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, somewhere under tests/ (say tests/test_repro.py), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on so
